Sample.evidence_source: [/page/0/Text/10] In this depression prevention trial, 341 high-risk adolescents (M age = 15.6, SD = 1.2) with elevated depressive symptoms were randomized to a brief group cognitive-behavioral (CB) intervention, group supportive-expressive intervention, bibliotherapy, or assessment-only control condition.
